item.title: How to get the last element of an array in JavaScript
item.description: Accessing the last element of arrays is essential for retrieving the most recent item, implementing stack operations, and getting final values in data processing within JavaScript applications. As the creator of CoreUI, I have accessed last elements extensively in components like activity feeds, pagination controls, and timeline displays where the final item often represents the current state or latest entry. From my extensive expertise, the most reliable and universally supported approach is using array index notation with array.length - 1 to access the final position. This method is dependable, works across all JavaScript versions, and clearly expresses the intent to access the last element.
